answer_1.quote: We conduct instruction tuning on MoCE using three distinct datasets. These include SlimOrca ... a curated version of the OpenOrca dataset comprising 518K multi-task examples; Magicoder , which contains 110K coding problems, providing a rich source for programming and algorithmic tasks; and MetaMathQA , consisting of 395K mathematical questions.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate solutions to mathematical problems, code, and answers to knowledge and reasoning questions.

answer_2.quote: All evaluations are performed under the same settings using lmevaluation-harness and bigcodeevaluation-harness.
